# LYNQED - Campus Marketplace 🎓🛒

**LYNQED** is a location-based hyper-local marketplace for university campuses.

---

## 🚀 Supabase SQL Setup

Copy and paste the following script into the **SQL Editor** in your Supabase Dashboard and click **Run**.

```sql
-- 1. Enable UUID Extension
create extension if not exists "uuid-ossp";

-- 2. Create helper function to check if a user is an admin
create or replace function public.is_admin()
returns boolean as $$
begin
  return exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles
    where id = auth.uid() and 'admin' = any(roles)
  );
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

-- 3. PROFILES Table
create table public.profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users on delete cascade primary key,
  email text unique not null,
  name text,
  avatar_url text,
  roles text[] default '{buyer}',
  phone_number text,
  is_banned boolean default false,
  address text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- 4. VENDORS Table
create table public.vendors (
  vendor_id text primary key,
  user_id uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade unique,
  store_name text not null,
  store_description text,
  store_avatar_url text,
  location text,
  is_approved boolean default false,
  rating numeric default 5.0,
  contact_phone text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- 5. PRODUCTS Table
create table public.products (
  id uuid default uuid_generate_v4() primary key,
  vendor_id text references public.vendors(vendor_id) on delete cascade,
  title text not null,
  description text,
  price numeric not null,
  currency text default 'GHS',
  category text,
  images text[],
  stock integer default 1,
  status text default 'pending', -- pending, approved, rejected
  location text,
  contact_phone text,
  rating numeric default 0.0,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- 6. COURIERS Table
create table public.couriers (
  id uuid default uuid_generate_v4() primary key,
  user_id uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade unique,
  full_name text not null,
  status text default 'pending', -- pending, approved, rejected, suspended
  vehicle_type text,
  transport_type text,
  online_status boolean default false,
  payout_method text,
  current_lat numeric,
  current_lng numeric,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- 7. ORDERS Table
create table public.orders (
  id uuid default uuid_generate_v4() primary key,
  buyer_id uuid references public.profiles(id),
  vendor_id text references public.vendors(vendor_id),
  courier_id uuid references public.profiles(id), -- links to rider profile
  items jsonb not null,
  total numeric not null,
  delivery_fee numeric default 0.0,
  status text default 'placed',
  delivery_option text not null, -- delivery, pickup
  location_coordinates jsonb, -- {lat, lng}
  pickup_coordinates jsonb, -- {lat, lng}
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- 8. NOTIFICATIONS System
create table public.notifications (
  id uuid default uuid_generate_v4() primary key,
  user_id uuid references public.profiles(id),
  target_role text, -- buyer, vendor, courier, admin
  target_scope text not null, -- individual, role, global
  type text not null, -- order, message, delivery, product, account, broadcast
  title text not null,
  message text not null,
  data_payload jsonb,
  priority text default 'normal',
  is_read boolean default false,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- 9. NOTIFICATION PREFERENCES
create table public.notification_preferences (
  user_id uuid references public.profiles(id) primary key,
  global_toggle boolean default true,
  in_app boolean default true,
  email boolean default true,
  push boolean default true,
  orders boolean default true,
  messages boolean default true,
  delivery boolean default true,
  promotions boolean default false,
  system_updates boolean default true
);

create table public.vendor_notification_preferences (
  user_id uuid references public.profiles(id) primary key,
  new_orders boolean default true,
  product_approval boolean default true,
  store_tips boolean default true,
  policy_changes boolean default true
);

-- 10. SUPPORT Tables
create table public.contact_messages (
  id uuid default uuid_generate_v4() primary key,
  name text,
  email text,
  message text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now())
);

create table public.payout_requests (
  id uuid default uuid_generate_v4() primary key,
  user_id uuid references public.profiles(id),
  amount numeric not null,
  method text,
  status text default 'pending',
  created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now())
);

-- 11. ENABLE RLS
alter table public.profiles enable row level security;
alter table public.vendors enable row level security;
alter table public.products enable row level security;
alter table public.orders enable row level security;
alter table public.couriers enable row level security;
alter table public.notifications enable row level security;
alter table public.notification_preferences enable row level security;
alter table public.vendor_notification_preferences enable row level security;

-- 12. RLS POLICIES

-- Profiles: Users can see all (for search/mentions), but only update own
create policy "Public profiles are viewable by everyone." on public.profiles for select using (true);
create policy "Users can update own profile." on public.profiles for update using (auth.uid() = id);

-- Vendors: Viewable by all, but only owner or admin can edit
create policy "Vendors are viewable by everyone." on public.vendors for select using (true);
create policy "Users can manage own vendor profile." on public.vendors for all using (auth.uid() = user_id or is_admin());

-- Products: Viewable by all, but only owner can edit
create policy "Products are viewable by everyone." on public.products for select using (true);
create policy "Vendors manage own products." on public.products for all using (
  exists (select 1 from public.vendors where vendors.vendor_id = products.vendor_id and vendors.user_id = auth.uid())
  or is_admin()
);

-- Orders: Involved parties or admin can see
create policy "Users see related orders." on public.orders for select using (
  auth.uid() = buyer_id 
  or auth.uid() = courier_id 
  or exists (select 1 from public.vendors where vendors.vendor_id = orders.vendor_id and vendors.user_id = auth.uid())
  or is_admin()
);
create policy "Buyers can insert orders." on public.orders for insert with check (auth.uid() = buyer_id);
create policy "Parties can update order status." on public.orders for update using (
  auth.uid() = buyer_id or auth.uid() = courier_id or is_admin() 
  or exists (select 1 from public.vendors where vendors.vendor_id = orders.vendor_id and vendors.user_id = auth.uid())
);

-- Notifications
create policy "Users see their own notifications" on public.notifications
  for select using (
    auth.uid() = user_id 
    or target_scope = 'global' 
    or (target_scope = 'role' and target_role = any(select unnest(roles) from public.profiles where id = auth.uid()))
  );
create policy "Admins manage notifications" on public.notifications for all using (is_admin());
create policy "Users update own notifications" on public.notifications for update using (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Preferences
create policy "Users manage own preferences" on public.notification_preferences for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);
create policy "Vendors manage own preferences" on public.vendor_notification_preferences for all using (auth.uid() = user_id);
```

---

## 🛠 Manual Steps

1.  **Storage**: Create a public bucket named `lynqed-assets`.
2.  **Auth**: In Supabase Auth settings, disable "Confirm Email" for faster testing during development.
3.  **Environment Variables**: Ensure your `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` match your project.

const safeSetItem = (key: string, value: string) => {
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`LocalStorage quota exceeded. Failed to save ${key}.`);
    }
};

const resolveCoordinates = (locationName: string): {lat: number, lng: number} | undefined => {
    const clean = locationName.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (INITIAL_LOCATION_CACHE[clean]) {
        return { lat: INITIAL_LOCATION_CACHE[clean][0], lng: INITIAL_LOCATION_CACHE[clean][1] };
    }
    const key = Object.keys(INITIAL_LOCATION_CACHE).find(k => clean.includes(k));
    if (key) {
        return { lat: INITIAL_LOCATION_CACHE[key][0], lng: INITIAL_LOCATION_CACHE[key][1] };
    }
    return { lat: 5.6506, lng: -0.1962 };
};

export const AppProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState<Vendor[]>([]);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Order[]>([]);
  const [couriers, setCouriers] = useState<Courier[]>([]);
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<User[]>([]);
  
  // Notification state
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);
  const [notificationPreferences, setNotificationPreferences] = useState<NotificationPreferences | null>(null);
  const [vendorPreferences, setVendorPreferences] = useState<VendorNotificationPreferences | null>(null);

  const [currentRole, setCurrentRole] = useState<Role>(() => {
      try { return (localStorage.getItem('lynqed_role') as Role) || 'guest'; } catch { return 'guest'; }
  });

  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<ThemeMode>(() => {
      try { return (localStorage.getItem('lynqed_theme_last') as ThemeMode) || 'system'; } catch { return 'system'; }
  });

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isDataLoading, setIsDataLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [connectionError, setConnectionError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<ToastMessage | null>(null);
  
  const [cart, setCart] = useState<CartItem[]>(() => {
      try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lynqed_cart') || '[]'); } catch { return []; }
  });
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState<string[]>(() => {
      try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lynqed_favs') || '[]'); } catch { return []; }
  });

  const unreadNotificationCount = notifications.filter(n => !n.isRead).length;

  useEffect(() => { safeSetItem('lynqed_cart', JSON.stringify(cart)); }, [cart]);
  useEffect(() => { safeSetItem('lynqed_favs', JSON.stringify(favorites)); }, [favorites]);
  
  useEffect(() => { 
      if (currentRole !== 'guest') {
          safeSetItem('lynqed_role', currentRole); 
      }
  }, [currentRole]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentUser) {
        const userTheme = localStorage.getItem(`lynqed_theme_${currentUser.id}`) as ThemeMode;
        if (userTheme) setTheme(userTheme);
    } else {
        const guestTheme = (localStorage.getItem('lynqed_theme_last') as ThemeMode) || 'system';
        setTheme(guestTheme);
    }
  }, [currentUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const applyTheme = (mode: ThemeMode) => {
        const root = window.document.documentElement;
        let isDark = mode === 'dark';
        if (mode === 'system') {
            isDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
        }

        if (isDark) root.classList.add('dark');
        else root.classList.remove('dark');

        safeSetItem('lynqed_theme_last', mode);
        if (currentUser) safeSetItem(`lynqed_theme_${currentUser.id}`, mode);
    };

    applyTheme(theme);

    if (theme === 'system') {
        const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
        const handler = () => applyTheme('system');
        mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handler);
        return () => mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handler);
    }
  }, [theme, currentUser]);

  const updateTheme = (newTheme: ThemeMode) => setTheme(newTheme);

  const vendorsRef = useRef(vendors);
  const currentUserRef = useRef(currentUser);
  const currentRoleRef = useRef(currentRole);

  useEffect(() => { vendorsRef.current = vendors; }, [vendors]);
  useEffect(() => { currentUserRef.current = currentUser; }, [currentUser]);
  useEffect(() => { currentRoleRef.current = currentRole; }, [currentRole]);

  useEffect(() => {
    initApp();
    try {
        const productSub = supabase.channel('public:products').on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'products' }, () => fetchData()).subscribe();
        const orderSub = supabase.channel('public:orders').on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'orders' }, (payload) => {
              fetchData();
          }).subscribe();

        const vendorSub = supabase.channel('public:vendors').on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'vendors' }, () => fetchData()).subscribe();
        
        // Notifications real-time sub
        const notifSub = supabase.channel('public:notifications').on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'notifications' }, () => {
             fetchNotifications();
        }).subscribe();

        return () => {
            supabase.removeChannel(productSub);
            supabase.removeChannel(orderSub);
            supabase.removeChannel(vendorSub);
            supabase.removeChannel(notifSub);
        };
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Realtime subscription failed:", e);
    }
  }, [currentUser]); // Re-sub if user changes

  const initApp = async () => {
      try {
          await checkSession();
          await fetchData();
          setConnectionError(false);
      } catch (e: any) {
          console.error("Initialization Failed:", e);
      } finally {
          setIsLoading(false);
          setIsDataLoading(false);
      }
  };

  const checkSession = async () => {
      try {
          const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
          if (error) throw error;
          if (data.session?.user) {
              await fetchUserProfile(data.session.user.id, data.session.user);
          } else {
              setCurrentUser(null);
              setCurrentRole('guest');
          }
      } catch (e: any) { 
          console.error("Session check error:", e);
      } 
  };

  const fetchUserProfile = async (userId: string, sessionUser?: any): Promise<User | null> => {
      try {
          const { data, error } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle();
          if (error) throw error;
          
          if (data) {
              if (data.isBanned) throw new Error("Account Suspended");
              
              const user: User = { 
                  ...data, 
                  roles: data.roles || ['buyer'],
                  avatarUrl: data.avatar_url,
                  phoneNumber: data.phone_number,
                  defaultLocation: data.address
              };
              
              setCurrentUser(user);
              
              const persistedRole = localStorage.getItem('lynqed_role') as Role;
              let finalRole: Role = 'buyer';

              if (user.roles.includes('admin')) {
                  finalRole = 'admin';
              } else if (persistedRole && user.roles.includes(persistedRole)) {
                  finalRole = persistedRole;
              } else if (user.roles.includes('vendor')) {
                  finalRole = 'vendor';
              } else if (user.roles.includes('courier')) {
                  finalRole = 'courier';
              } else if (user.roles.includes('buyer')) {
                  finalRole = 'buyer';
              }
              
              setCurrentRole(finalRole);
              if (finalRole !== 'guest') safeSetItem('lynqed_role', finalRole);
              
              fetchNotifications();
              fetchNotificationPreferences(userId);

              return user;
          } else if (sessionUser) {
              const { error: insertError } = await supabase.from('profiles').insert({
                  id: userId,
                  email: sessionUser.email,
                  name: sessionUser.user_metadata?.full_name || sessionUser.email?.split('@')[0] || 'New User',
                  roles: ['buyer']
              });
              if (!insertError) return fetchUserProfile(userId, undefined);
          }
      } catch (e: any) {
          console.error("Profile fetch error", e);
      }
      return null;
  };

  const fetchNotifications = async () => {
    if (!currentUserRef.current) return;
    try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase.from('notifications')
            .select('*')
            .or(`user_id.eq.${currentUserRef.current.id},target_scope.eq.global,target_role.eq.${currentRoleRef.current}`)
            .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
        
        if (error) throw error;
        if (data) {
            setNotifications(data.map(n => ({
                id: n.id,
                userId: n.user_id,
                targetRole: n.target_role,
                targetScope: n.target_scope,
                type: n.type,
                title: n.title,
                message: n.message,
                dataPayload: n.data_payload,
                priority: n.priority,
                isRead: n.is_read,
                createdAt: n.created_at
            })));
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Fetch notifications error", e);
    }
  };

  const fetchNotificationPreferences = async (userId: string) => {
      try {
          const { data: mainPrefs } = await supabase.from('notification_preferences').select('*').eq('user_id', userId).maybeSingle();
          if (mainPrefs) setNotificationPreferences({
              userId: mainPrefs.user_id,
              globalToggle: mainPrefs.global_toggle,
              // Fixed: in_app -> inApp to match NotificationPreferences interface
              inApp: mainPrefs.in_app,
              email: mainPrefs.email,
              push: mainPrefs.push,
              orders: mainPrefs.orders,
              messages: mainPrefs.messages,
              delivery: mainPrefs.delivery,
              promotions: mainPrefs.promotions,
              systemUpdates: mainPrefs.system_updates
          });

          const { data: vPrefs } = await supabase.from('vendor_notification_preferences').select('*').eq('user_id', userId).maybeSingle();
          if (vPrefs) setVendorPreferences({
              userId: vPrefs.user_id,
              newOrders: vPrefs.new_orders,
              productApproval: vPrefs.product_approval,
              storeTips: vPrefs.store_tips,
              policyChanges: vPrefs.policy_changes
          });
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const fetchData = async () => {
      try {
          const fetchSafely = async (table: string, select = '*', orderBy?: string) => {
             try {
                let query = supabase.from(table).select(select);
                if (orderBy) query = query.order(orderBy, { ascending: false });
                const { data, error } = await query;
                if (error) throw error;
                return data;
             } catch (e: any) { return null; }
          };

          const [pData, vData, oData, cDataRaw] = await Promise.all([
              fetchSafely('products', '*', 'created_at'),
              fetchSafely('vendors'),
              fetchSafely('orders', '*', 'created_at'),
              fetchSafely('couriers')
          ]);

          if (pData) setProducts(pData.map((p: any) => ({ ...p, vendorId: p.vendor_id, contactPhone: p.contact_phone })) as Product[]);
          if (vData) setVendors(vData.map((v: any) => ({ ...v, vendorId: v.vendor_id, storeName: v.store_name, storeDescription: v.store_description, storeAvatarUrl: v.store_avatar_url, userId: v.user_id, isApproved: v.is_approved, contactPhone: v.contact_phone })) as Vendor[]);
          if (oData) setOrders(oData.map((o: any) => ({ ...o, vendorId: o.vendor_id, buyerId: o.buyer_id, courierId: o.courier_id, deliveryFee: o.delivery_fee, deliveryOption: o.delivery_option, createdAt: o.created_at, items: typeof o.items === 'string' ? JSON.parse(o.items) : o.items, locationCoordinates: o.location_coordinates, pickupCoordinates: o.pickup_coordinates })) as Order[]);

          if (cDataRaw) {
              const userIds = [...new Set(cDataRaw.map((d: any) => d.user_id).filter(Boolean))];
              const { data: profiles } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('id, name, email').in('id', userIds);
              const profileMap = new Map<string, any>(profiles?.map((p: any) => [p.id, p]) || []);
              setCouriers(cDataRaw.map((d: any) => ({ ...d, userId: d.user_id, fullName: profileMap.get(d.user_id)?.name || d.full_name || 'Courier', vehicleType: d.vehicle_type, onlineStatus: d.online_status, status: d.status, verified: d.status === 'approved', payoutMethod: d.payout_method })) as Courier[]);
          }

          if (localStorage.getItem('lynqed_role') === 'admin') {
              const uData = await supabase.from('profiles').select('*');
              if (uData.data) setUsers(uData.data as any);
          }
      } catch (e: any) { 
          console.error("Data Fetch Error:", e);
      } finally { 
          setIsDataLoading(false); 
      }
  };

  const login = async (email: string, pass: string) => {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password: pass });
      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
      if (data.user) {
          const user = await fetchUserProfile(data.user.id, data.user);
          if (!user) return { success: false, error: "Profile missing" };
          await fetchData();
          let detRole: Role = 'buyer';
          if (user.roles.includes('admin')) detRole = 'admin';
          else if (user.roles.includes('vendor')) detRole = 'vendor';
          else if (user.roles.includes('courier')) detRole = 'courier';
          return { success: true, role: detRole }; 
      }
      return { success: false };
  };

  const signup = async (email: string, password: string, fullName: string, role: Role, phoneNumber?: string) => {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password, options: { data: { full_name: fullName, roles: [role] } } });
      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
      if (data.user) {
           await supabase.from('profiles').insert({ id: data.user.id, email, name: fullName, roles: [role], phone_number: phoneNumber });
           await login(email, password); 
           return { success: true, user: data.user };
      }
      return { success: false };
  };

  const logout = async () => {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      localStorage.removeItem('lynqed_role');
      setCurrentUser(null);
      setCurrentRole('guest');
      setCart([]);
      setNotifications([]);
  };

  const resetPassword = async (email: string) => {
      const origin = window.location.origin;
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { 
          redirectTo: `${origin}/update-password` 
      });
      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
      return { success: true };
  };

  const updatePassword = async (password: string) => {
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password });
      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
      return { success: true };
  };

  const switchRole = (role: Role) => { 
      if(currentUser?.roles.includes(role)) {
          setCurrentRole(role); 
          safeSetItem('lynqed_role', role);
          showToast(`Switched to ${role.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + role.slice(1)} Mode`, 'info');
          fetchNotifications(); // Refresh notifications for new role
      }
  };

  const updateProfile = async (data: Partial<User>) => {
      if(!currentUser) return { success: false };
      const updatePayload: any = {};
      if (data.name) updatePayload.name = data.name;
      if (data.avatarUrl) updatePayload.avatar_url = data.avatarUrl;
      if (data.phoneNumber) updatePayload.phone_number = data.phoneNumber;
      if (data.address) updatePayload.address = data.address;
      const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').update(updatePayload).eq('id', currentUser.id);
      if(!error) {
          showToast("Profile updated", "success");
          fetchUserProfile(currentUser.id);
          return { success: true };
      }
      return { success: false };
  };

  // Notification methods
  const markNotificationAsRead = async (id: string) => {
      await supabase.from('notifications').update({ is_read: true }).eq('id', id);
      setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === id ? { ...n, isRead: true } : n));
  };

  const markAllNotificationsRead = async () => {
      if (!currentUser) return;
      await supabase.from('notifications').update({ is_read: true }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id);
      setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({ ...n, isRead: true })));
  };

  const deleteNotification = async (id: string) => {
      await supabase.from('notifications').delete().eq('id', id);
      setNotifications(prev => prev.filter(n => n.id !== id));
  };

  const updateNotificationPreferences = async (prefs: Partial<NotificationPreferences>) => {
      if (!currentUser) return;
      const payload = {
          global_toggle: prefs.globalToggle,
          // Fixed: prefs.in_app -> prefs.inApp to match interface
          in_app: prefs.inApp,
          email: prefs.email,
          push: prefs.push,
          orders: prefs.orders,
          messages: prefs.messages,
          delivery: prefs.delivery,
          promotions: prefs.promotions,
          system_updates: prefs.systemUpdates
      };
      // remove undefined keys
      Object.keys(payload).forEach(key => (payload as any)[key] === undefined && delete (payload as any)[key]);
      
      const { error } = await supabase.from('notification_preferences').upsert({ user_id: currentUser.id, ...payload });
      if (!error) {
          showToast("Preferences saved", "success");
          fetchNotificationPreferences(currentUser.id);
      }
  };

  const updateVendorPreferences = async (prefs: Partial<VendorNotificationPreferences>) => {
      if (!currentUser) return;
      const payload = {
          // Fixed: Changed property access from snake_case to camelCase as per interface
          new_orders: prefs.newOrders,
          product_approval: prefs.productApproval,
          store_tips: prefs.storeTips,
          policy_changes: prefs.policyChanges
      };
      Object.keys(payload).forEach(key => (payload as any)[key] === undefined && delete (payload as any)[key]);

      const { error } = await supabase.from('vendor_notification_preferences').upsert({ user_id: currentUser.id, ...payload });

          showToast("Vendor preferences saved", "success");
          fetchNotificationPreferences(currentUser.id);
      }
  };

          target_role: role,
          type: 'broadcast',
          title,
          message,
          priority: 'normal',
          is_read: false
      });

      if(!error) showToast("Message sent!", "success");
      return { success: !error };
  };

      return { success: !error };
  };

      try {
          const fileName = `${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2)}_${Date.now()}.${file.name.split('.').pop()}`;
          const filePath = `${folder}/${fileName}`;
          const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage.from('lynqed-assets').upload(filePath, file);

          const { data } = supabase.storage.from('lynqed-assets').getPublicUrl(filePath);
          return data.publicUrl;
      } catch (error: any) (
          console.error("Upload Error:", error);
          showToast('Image upload failed', 'error');
          return null;
      }
  };

  const registerVendor = async (data: any): Promise<{ success: boolean }> => {
      if(!currentUser) return { success: false };
      
      const existingVendor = vendors.find(v => v.userId === currentUser.id);
      const vid = existingVendor?.vendorId || `v-${Date.now()}`;
      
      const upsertData = { 
          vendor_id: vid, 
          user_id: currentUser.id, 
          store_name: data.storeName, 
          store_description: data.storeDescription, 
          location: data.location, 
          contact_phone: data.contactPhone, 
          store_avatar_url: data.storeAvatarUrl, 
          is_approved: existingVendor ? existingVendor.isApproved : false, 
          rating: existingVendor ? existingVendor.rating : 5.0 
      };

      const { error } = await supabase.from('vendors').upsert(upsertData, { onConflict: 'user_id' });

      if (!error) {
          if (!currentUser.roles.includes('vendor')) {
              const roles = [...new Set([...currentUser.roles, 'vendor' as Role])];
              await supabase.from('profiles').update({ roles }).eq('id', currentUser.id);
          }
          await fetchData(); 
          return { success: true };
      } else {
          console.error("Vendor Upsert Error:", error);
          showToast(`Error: ${error.message || 'Check SQL console for details'}`, "error");
          return { success: false };
      }
  };
  
  const registerCourier = async (data: any, explicitUserId?: string): Promise<{ success: boolean }> => {
      const uid = explicitUserId || currentUser?.id;
      if(!uid) return { success: false };
      const { error } = await supabase.from('couriers').insert({ 
          user_id: uid, 
          status: 'pending', 
          full_name: data.fullName, 
          vehicle_type: data.vehicle_type, 
          transport_type: data.transport_type, 
          payout_method: data.payout_method, 
          delivery_radius: data.delivery_radius 
      });
      if(!error) { 
          showToast("Application submitted", "success"); 
          fetchData(); 
          return { success: true }; 
      }
      return { success: false };
  };
  
  const addProduct = async (prod: any) => {
      if(!currentUser) return false;
      const v = vendors.find(v => v.userId === currentUser.id);

Here is the breakdown of the specific conditions and "glory moments" for each role:

Buyers see the system at work during the lifecycle of their hunger or need.

Vendors experience notifications as a high-stakes feed of incoming revenue and administrative milestones.
*   **The Glory Moment:** A vendor is sitting in a lecture when a "High Priority" blue notification hits their dashboard: *"New Order Received! You have a new order (#A4C2) for ₵85.00."*

### 3. The Courier: "The Dispatch Feed"
For couriers, notifications are literally their "Job Board." They rely on **Role-Scoped** notifications.
*   **The Glory Moment:** A courier is "Online" and waiting near the student union. Suddenly, a broadcast hits every courier's device simultaneously: *"New Delivery Available! An order is ready for delivery near Jean Nelson Hall."*
